headline.en: Review skill permissions before an update becomes trusted.
headline.zh: 在信任更新前检查 Skill 权限。

sub.en: skillsig compares a skill’s declared scope with its frontmatter grants and a saved baseline, then checks its signature bundle.
sub.zh: skillsig 比较 Skill 声明范围、frontmatter 授权与已保存基线，再检查签名 bundle。

body.en: Tool patterns are checked against manifest scope.
body.zh: 工具模式与 manifest 范围进行比较。

body.en: A saved reviewed scope can expose later growth.
body.zh: 已保存检查范围可揭示后续扩张。

body.en: JSON, SARIF and exit codes support automation.
body.zh: JSON、SARIF 与退出码可接入自动化。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Verify the bundled skill fixture directory against an empty isolated baseline path.
note.zh: 使用空的独立基线路径验证随仓 Skill fixture 目录。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Read-only scope and signature verification of bundled synthetic skills using a separate absent baseline path; no skill is executed and no trust baseline is written.

body.en: Verify the bundled skill fixture directory against an empty isolated baseline path.
body.zh: 使用空的独立基线路径验证随仓 Skill fixture 目录。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/skillsig.git
cd skillsig
go build ./cmd/skillsig

limitations.en: The Sigstore keyless backend is not wired in this build; --dev uses an ephemeral Ed25519 key.
limitations.zh: 当前构建未接通 Sigstore keyless 后端；--dev 使用临时 Ed25519 密钥。

limitations.en: Manifest scope checks do not enforce runtime filesystem or network isolation. A signature is not proof of benign behavior.
limitations.zh: Manifest 范围检查不执行运行时文件系统或网络隔离；签名也不证明行为安全。

limitations.en: The demo only inspects bundled synthetic skills and writes no trust baseline.
limitations.zh: 示例只检查随仓合成 Skill，不写入信任基线。

body.en: A skill update can broaden allowed tools without changing the task you installed it for. A reviewed manifest and baseline make that expansion visible during verification.
body.zh: Skill 更新可能扩大允许工具，而安装它的任务并未改变。经过检查的 manifest 与基线使权限扩张在验证时可见。

body.en: Manifest parsing combines SKILL.md and SKILLSIG.yaml inputs. The scope scanner checks grants and prior lock entries. Signature verification contributes to TRUSTED, UNSIGNED or SCOPE-DRIFTED verdicts, which are rendered as a table, JSON or SARIF.
body.zh: Manifest 解析器读取 SKILL.md 与 SKILLSIG.yaml；范围扫描器比较授权与既有锁记录。签名校验共同决定 TRUSTED、UNSIGNED 或 SCOPE-DRIFTED，再渲染为表格、JSON 或 SARIF。

body.en: Manifest parsing combines SKILL.md and SKILLSIG.yaml inputs. The scope scanner checks grants and prior lock entries. Signature verification contributes to TRUSTED, UNSIGNED or SCOPE-DRIFTED verdicts, which are rendered as a table, JSON or SARIF.
body.zh: Manifest 解析器读取 SKILL.md 与 SKILLSIG.yaml；范围扫描器比较授权与既有锁记录。签名校验共同决定 TRUSTED、UNSIGNED 或 SCOPE-DRIFTED，再渲染为表格、JSON 或 SARIF。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: SKILLSIG_HOME relocates the local lock storage. Plain verify is read-only; --trust records only currently trusted scopes. --force-trust with --trust explicitly rebaselines drifted entries and should follow a scope review. --json and --sarif select structured reports.
body.zh: SKILLSIG_HOME 可更改本地锁存储位置。普通 verify 只读；--trust 只记录当前受信任范围。--force-trust 配合 --trust 显式重置漂移基线，应先检查权限变化。--json 与 --sarif 输出结构化报告。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/skillsig verify ./testdata/skills/ --no-color
go run ./cmd/skillsig verify ./testdata/skills/ --json
# CI rejects unsigned or drifted rows:
skillsig verify ./skills --ci --sarif results.sarif
